name: Shakti parietal session, left side: burst stand-in for the caudate signal (untested, 30 min)
summary: Murphy expects his caudate nucleus ('body') signal over the left parietal lobe to be arousing (energy and excitement, possibly anger or sexual desire), from a few reports with other placements; he says it has not been tested there. The signal is published only by name; the project's amygdala-type burst stands in for it.
setting: Darkness and quiet (the vendor says effects during a session need darkness and silence); eyes closed, relaxed, without meditating or falling asleep; no meditation, mind machines or drugs at the same time.
schedule: Vendor's Shakti rules: at most every 72 h or once a week, never on consecutive days; a series of 3 or 6 sessions, then a 21-day break. Keep to it even though parietal thresholds are higher, and stay with parietal placement for the whole series.
notes: The vendor: 'The Caudate Nuclear Signal has not been tested over the left parietal lobe ... There are no reports from sessions with this design so far, however' (l_parietal.htm). The expected arousal comes from 'these few preliminary reports' with other placements. For one parietal lobe it says to 'begin by using only two coils with non-alternating signals' ('Using the 8-Coil Shakti Over the Parietal Lobes'). Played here: two coils, CP1 near the top (-) and CP5 low on the side (+), after the vendor's two-coil photo; the site names are the project's reading. The waveform is the project's amygdala stand-in: a rising sweep, 6 to 30 Hz, 230 points of 3 ms (0.69 s), then 4 s of silence. The vendor gives no shape or timing for the caudate signal, so nothing played is specific to it. The 30 min is the vendor's general session length. Field strength: the vendor's 10 to 50 mG are gaussmeter readings at a coil (FAQ). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT that is about 24 uT at the scalp and 56 uT at the coil face, 11 to 56 times the vendor's level. No report of this session exists. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Murphy names anger among the possible effects of the left side: stop if irritable or angry. The project's own precaution: do not follow this session with a left amygdala session. Other forms: murphy-shakti-caudate-parietal-bilateral-fast and murphy-shakti-caudate-parietal-bilateral-slow. The vendor says parietal thresholds are 'a bit higher' but asks users to keep to the normal schedules and not to switch between parietal and other placements. Not for people with epilepsy; stop at once if distressed.
